git_state.last_commit_message: Refactor CSS into style.css, finalize layout and content

summary.what_we_were_doing: Building a portfolio website for Chris Gilbreath (screenwriter, author, composer) at chrisg.media — a single-page site with dark scorched-earth aesthetic, real book covers, composer credits from IMDB, and book description modals.
key_decisions: Single HTML file + external style.css — no framework, pure HTML/CSS/JS for easy Vercel deployment
Dela Gothic One for hero display font — after cycling through Caveat (too soft), New Rocker (WoW energy), Rubik Dirt (Honey I Shrunk the Kids), Cinzel Decorative (warlock vibes)

Color palette: scorched earth — bg #0b0906, accent #b07830 (tobacco amber), steel #7a5c30. Blood red was rejected, zombie green was rejected, steel blue clashed. Tobacco amber Option B won over rust sienna Option A.
Section order: About → Books → Credits → Screenplays → Contact — user reordered several times
Screenplays section is a holding page (no real scripts listed yet) — Chris said he'll post samples when ready
Book covers use object-fit: cover with 102%/margin: -1% trick to hide white JPEG borders baked into Amazon cover images. Starr County Line uses object-position: center, others use top.
Book cards open a text-only modal (no image in modal) with full Amazon descriptions
Credits section is composer/soundtrack credits from IMDB only — no screenwriting credits listed yet
CSS was extracted from index.html into style.css in a later commit
current_blockers: Real screenplay titles not provided yet — Screenplays section is a placeholder
Site not yet deployed to Vercel — remote is set (git@github.com:teezlabs/chrisgilbreath-screenwriter.git) but no Vercel project connected
next_steps: Push to GitHub and connect to Vercel for deployment to chrisg.media
Get real screenplay titles from Chris to populate the Screenplays section
Confirm contact email info@chrisg.media is live and receiving
Add any additional books or credits as Chris provides them
summary.important_context: Client: Chris Gilbreath — screenwriter, author, composer. Based in Philadelphia, PA. Domain: chrisg.media. Email: info@chrisg.media. Books: Starr County Line (standalone border noir, 1975 TX), Bad Blood + Sixteen: Bounty Hunter (The Sixteen Series — genetic sci-fi/crime thriller). Composer credits: Manifest West (2022), Pandemic Response (2021), Mrs. Murphy's Confession (2018), Addicted to Porn: Chasing the Cardboard Butterfly (2017). Live server running on port 5500. User wants sarcastic/sassy tone in responses. Font stack: Dela Gothic One (hero), Cormorant Garamond (section titles/editorial), Bebas Neue (labels/nav), Lora (body). No framework — avoid adding one unless asked.
